title: Guide reader TOC stays with the article
lede: The right-rail On this page list now stays pinned while you scroll a guide, and the active section marker moves as headings pass.

sections.heading: Scrolled guide · after only
sections.note: No matched before PNG of the scrolled state. Before the fix, align-items: start shrank the TOC column to 292px against a 7148px article, so sticky had no travel and the rail left the viewport. After captures are Cursor IDE Chromium at 1920×1080 CSS pixels, ADMIN Erik Role, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000 on 2026-09-19. Route: /resources/color-correction-101.

shots.title: Pinned at Curve adjustment
shots.cap: Deep in Color Correction 101, On this page stays in the right rail at top: 80px. Curve adjustment is the active item. The article has scrolled past the title.

shots.title: TOC click to White balance
shots.cap: Clicking White balance in the rail scrolled the heading into view (96px from the top) and moved the active marker. The rail stayed pinned.

sections.heading: Top of page · before (unrelated to the scroll bug)
sections.note: Captured before the stretch/sticky CSS change. At rest the rail was already visible; the bug only appeared after scrolling.

shots.title: TOC at rest
shots.cap: The rail sits beside the article at the top of Color Correction 101. This layout at rest is not the failure; the column was only as tall as this list.

changes.was: The reader grid used align-items: start, so the TOC column was only as tall as the list. Sticky had nowhere to travel and the rail scrolled away.
changes.now: The grid stretches the TOC column to the article height. The inner panel is position: sticky with top: 5rem so it clears the app header.

changes.was: The current heading class toggled, but you could not see it once the rail left the viewport.
changes.now: A sliding marker follows the active heading as you scroll or click an On this page row.
